title: Envelope every HTTP-style contract example must follow
description: Validated by tools/validate_examples.py against every examples/*.json that has an 'http' key (the package manifest example is a different, instance-style shape and is exempt -- see package-layout.md).

schema.description: response must always name a schema (even a {"type":"null"} one for a bodyless response, e.g. a 302); request may be null only when request.body is also null (a GET with no body to validate).

stable_fields.description: JSON pointers, rooted at response.body, of fields automated tests must assert byte-equal against this fixture. Everything else in the body is server-generated (ids, tokens, timestamps) and should only be asserted for shape/type, not exact value. May be empty when the whole response is server-generated.
